headline: Edouard Balladur, former French prime minister, dies at age 97
description: Former secretary general of the Elysée under Georges Pompidou, negotiator of the Grenelle Agreements in 1968 and head of François Mitterrand's government in 1993, he failed to win the presidential elections of 1995 against Jacques Chirac. This key figure of France's Fifth Republic has died at the age of 97.

headline: Messi announces retirement from international football
description: At 39, eight-time Ballon d'Or winner Lionel Messi announced on Instagram that he was ending his international football career, which has seen him win a World Cup and two Copa America titles for Argentina.

headline: Jean-François Leroy, director of the Visa pour l'Image photojournalism festival, has died
description: Leroy, the founder of the unmissable journalistic event and a strong-willed figure who fought to defend photojournalists' work for nearly 40 years, died in Paris on Monday at age 69.
